Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the Walla Walla state veterans' home.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the Walla Walla state veterans' home;amending RCW 72.36.035; adding a new section to chapter 72.36 RCW; andproviding a contingent effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be established and maintained in this state a branch ofthe state soldiers' home, under the name of the "Walla Walla stateveterans' home," which shall be a home for veterans and their spouseswho meet admission requirements contained in RCW 72.36.030.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 72.36.035 and 2002 c 292 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of this chapter, unless the context clearly indicatesotherwise: (1) "Actual bona fide residents of this state" means persons whohave a domicile in the state of Washington immediately prior toapplication for admission to a state veterans' home. p. 1 SSB 6507 (2) "Department" means the Washington state department of veteransaffairs. (3) "Domicile" means a person's true, fixed, and permanent home andplace of habitation, and shall be the place where the person intends toremain, and to which the person expects to return when the personleaves without intending to establish a new domicile elsewhere. (4) "State veterans' homes" means the Washington soldiers' home andcolony in Orting, the Washington veterans' home in Retsil, ((and)) theeastern Washington veterans' home, and the Walla Walla state veterans'home. (5) "Veteran" has the same meaning established in RCW 41.04.007.

This act takes effect upon certification bythe director of the office of financial management that sufficient andspecific funding, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, hasbeen provided by June 30, 2012, in the omnibus capital appropriationsact for the state funds required by the United States department ofveterans affairs state home construction grant program for theconstruction of the state soldiers' home created in section 1 of thisact. A notice of certification must be filed with the code reviser forpublication in the state register. If a certificate is not filed bythe director of the office of financial management by June 30, 2012,this act is null and void.
